1: // Simple Pixel Dodge game
2: (function(){
3:   const canvas=document.getElementById('game');
4:   if(!canvas){ console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found'); return; }
5:   const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   const WIDTH=canvas.width=400;
7:   const HEIGHT=canvas.height=600;
8: 
9:   const player={w:40,h:20,x:WIDTH/2-20,y:HEIGHT-30, speed:5};
10:   const keys={left:false,right:false};
11:   const circles=[];
12:   let spawnTimer=0, spawnInterval=60; // frames
13:   let speedIncrement=0.02; // increase fall speed over time
14:   let baseFallSpeed=2;
15:   let score=0;
16:   let gameOver=false;
17: 
18:   function update(){
19:     if(gameOver) return;
20:     // move player
21:     if(keys.left) player.x-=player.speed;
22:     if(keys.right) player.x+=player.speed;
23:     player.x=Math.max(0, Math.min(WIDTH-player.w, player.x));
24: 
25:     // spawn circles
26:     if(--spawnTimer<=0){
27:       const radius=Math.random()*15+10;
28:       circles.push({x:Math.random()*(WIDTH-radius*2)+radius, y:-radius, r:radius, speed:baseFallSpeed+Math.random()*2});
29:       spawnTimer=spawnInterval;
30:       spawnInterval=Math.max(20, spawnInterval-1); // faster spawning
31:     }
32: 
33:     // update circles
34:     for(let i=circles.length-1;i>=0;i--){
35:       const c=circles[i];
36:       c.y+=c.speed;
37:       // collision with player
38:       if(c.y + c.r > player.y && c.x > player.x && c.x < player.x+player.w){
39:         gameOver=true; break;
40:       }
41:       // remove off-screen
42:       if(c.y - c.r > HEIGHT) circles.splice(i,1), score++;
43:     }
44:     if(!gameOver) score++; // increase score each frame
45:   }
46: 
47:   function draw(){
48:     ctx.clearRect(0,0,WIDTH,HEIGHT);
49:     // player
50:     ctx.fillStyle='blue';
51:     ctx.fillRect(player.x,player.y,player.w,player.h);
52:     // circles
53:     ctx.fillStyle='red';
54:     circles.forEach(c=>{ ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(c.x,c.y,c.r,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); });
55:     // score
56:     ctx.fillStyle='black';
57:     ctx.font='16px sans-serif';
58:     ctx.fillText('Score: '+score,10,20);
59:     if(gameOver){
60:       ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
61:       ctx.fillRect(0,0,WIDTH,HEIGHT);
62:       ctx.fillStyle='white';
63:       ctx.textAlign='center';
64:       ctx.font='30px sans-serif';
65:       ctx.fillText('Game Over',WIDTH/2,HEIGHT/2);
66:     }
67:   }
68: 
69:   function loop(){
70:     update();
71:     draw();
72:     if(!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
73:   }
74: 
75:   // input handling
76:   window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{ if(e.key==='ArrowLeft' || e.key==='a') keys.left=true; if(e.key==='ArrowRight' || e.key==='d') keys.right=true; });
77:   window.addEventListener('keyup',e=>{ if(e.key==='ArrowLeft' || e.key==='a') keys.left=false; if(e.key==='ArrowRight' || e.key==='d') keys.right=false; });
78: 
79:   loop();
80: })();

(End of file - total 80 lines)
